VIVIMOD-BLACK_MAGE_STAFF.title: Black Mage Staff
VIVIMOD-BLACK_MAGE_STAFF.description: Playing Black Magic outside Trance grants 20 Trance. Gain 5 Trance for each HP lost. At 100 Trance, enter Trance. While in Trance, playing an original Black Magic card consumes 20 Trance and adds a free Ethereal copy to your hand. Copies cannot trigger this effect.
VIVIMOD-BLACK_MAGE_STAFF.flavor: A staff carried by a young black mage, brimming with untapped magical potential.
